categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures and sells stainless steel cold-rolled products, specifically stainless steel cold-rolled sheets. It procures stainless steel hot coils externally and processes them through in-house cold rolling. The company serves diverse industries including large home appliance manufacturers, sinks, automotive parts, boilers, construction, and industrial parts. The paper manufacturing segment was excluded due to loss of control over a subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses cold rolling and heat treatment processes, including coil polishing lines (CPL) with unique embossing and hairline pattern manufacturing technologies protected by patents. It operates integrated production facilities from rolling to slitting, enabling flexible production of various stainless steel grades and widths. The production capacity is based on advanced rolling mills with high utilization rates and proprietary processing lines for wide coils.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic and international home appliance companies, kitchenware manufacturers, automotive parts suppliers, boiler makers, construction firms, and industrial parts producers. The company targets both domestic and export markets, with exports to Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America. The home appliance sector accounts for about 60% of sales volume, providing a stable demand base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities located in Yesan and Gimhae. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports products to Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, and Mexico. The company monitors global market trends and government policies to strategically expand its presence in international stainless steel and related markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the stainless steel supply chain, focusing on processing stainless steel hot coils into cold-rolled sheets. It sources raw materials externally and adds value through cold rolling, heat treatment, polishing, and cutting processes. It also functions as a coil center, customizing products to customer specifications and delivering directly to end users, thus bridging upstream raw material suppliers and downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high value-added product lines such as ultra-thin sheets and precision clad products, enhancing cost competitiveness, and improving delivery reliability. The company invests in new production facilities like the Gimhae plant to strengthen quality and supply stability for global home appliance customers. R&D focuses on proprietary embossing and hairline pattern technologies, with patents supporting product differentiation. The company is exploring diversification into drone and unmanned aerial vehicle markets, though currently in market exploration phase.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of stainless steel cold-rolled sheets and related by-products. The company sells both domestically and internationally, with payment terms including cash within two months for domestic sales and various payment methods such as sight draft and T/T for exports. Additional minor revenues come from by-product sales and solar-related sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds approximately 5% market share in the domestic stainless steel cold-rolled sheet market, ranking third behind POSCO and BNG Steel. It competes in a highly competitive market where price and quality are critical. The company leverages cost advantages, flexible production, and strong customer relationships to maintain a stable position against larger competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company has total assets of approximately 151 billion KRW and equity of about 97.7 billion KRW. Annual sales were around 201 billion KRW in 2023, down from 239 billion KRW in 2022, reflecting a challenging global steel market. The company experienced operating losses in 2023 but continues efforts to improve productivity and financial structure. It has a production capacity of 72,000 metric tons annually with actual production around 61,786 metric tons in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its 50 years of specialization in stainless steel manufacturing, offering a wide range of grades and widths with flexible, customer-tailored production. Its patented embossing and hairline technologies provide unique surface finishes not widely available in the market. The integrated production system from rolling to finishing enables rapid delivery and high-quality products. Cost competitiveness is achieved through optimized operations and direct sales to end users, enhancing customer value.
